title: Hardwired circuit language
statement: Let $a$ assign a natural number of fixed input bits to each input length, let $D_n$ be a Boolean circuit on $n+a(n)$ inputs for each $n$, and choose an assignment $\alpha_n$ to those $a(n)$ bits. The language accepted by the family obtained by fixing these bits to $\alpha_n$ consists exactly of the words $w$ for which $D_{|w|}$ accepts the concatenation of $w$ and $\alpha_{|w|}$.
hypotheses_covered: A function $a:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ specifying the number of fixed bits at each length
For each $n$, a circuit $D_n$ on $n+a(n)$ inputs
For each $n$, an assignment $\alpha_n$ to the $a(n)$ fixed inputs
